entities.name: Bogardan
entities.description: A volcanic mountain island, one of the three main islands of the Burning Isles on Dominaria, home to embermages.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Land of hellish demons controlled by the lich Nevinyrral, at war with Bogardan.

entities.name: Nevinyrral
entities.description: Lich who controlled the demons of Urborg.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The most powerful site of red mana on Dominaria.

entities.name: Emberwilde Order
entities.description: Order that has not moved into Bogardan for fear of insulting the entities in its depths.

entities.name: Wildfire
entities.description: Plane reached by portals on Bogardan.

events.summary: Bogardan was at war with the demons of Urborg, controlled by Nevinyrral.
events.quote: Bogardan once was at war with the hellish demons of Urborg
